briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier model race with new reasoning agents

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced multi-agent systems. Funding surges past $11B this quarter amid regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4-preview with enhanced agent orchestration. xAI's Grok-4 achieves top scores on agent benchmarks. Anthropic and Google DeepMind follow with Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships next-gen Blackwell clusters to major labs. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU data centers in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for autonomous systems by 2027?
